description: Canonical free-first routing policy owned solely by cline-model-optimizer for Agent Foundry v3. Pi launchers pin policyVersion (and optionally sha256) or validate live config against this file before routing.
orderRule: model-major: each free model runs across Pi accounts 1,2,3 in order before advancing to the next free model. Subscription tail runs only after all 9 free legs are exhausted.

staleAliasesCorrected.note: Missing minor version (.1). Core-id matching still resolves the old string, but policy and tier lists use v4.1.
Subscription tail was pinned to the v4 id; corrected to v4.1 to match the free canonical.
GLM Flash free id rides the cline provider with the z-ai/ prefix. Do NOT rewrite it to cline-free/.
Short display name; canonical config id keeps the -contributor suffix.

quota.meaning: Free/subscription budget for this leg is exhausted today. Advance the route queue (next account, then next model).

auth.meaning: Credential invalid, expired, or missing. Do NOT advance the queue as if budget were spent; surface re-sign-in. Cline exposes only the active login, so other accounts stay 'unknown' until signed in.

transient.meaning: Network or server hiccup. Retry the same leg with backoff; do NOT advance the queue.

capability.pi: Pi launchers MAY rotate isolated account profiles (account-1/account-2/account-3) per this queue; each profile carries its own credentials and budget.
capability.cline: The Cline VS Code extension exposes only the ACTIVE login on disk. This tool never claims automatic switching of unavailable Cline credentials: legs for other Cline logins are advisory ('sign in to unlock') until that login has authenticated on this machine with VS Code closed.

ownership.router: cline-model-optimizer (sole routing-policy owner for Agent Foundry v3)
consumers: Agent Foundry v3 launchers (pin or validate this policy)
interop gateway (forwards route decisions, never reorders them)
ownership.nonOwners: Foundry and the interop gateway MUST NOT define competing model/account orders; they consume this policy.

pinning.howTo: Pin policyVersion + sha256 of this file in launcher config; at startup call Test-CmoFoundryRoutePolicy to validate a local copy, and Get-CmoFoundryRouteQueue to enumerate legs. Reject any config with paid legs or a different free order.
